start: Admin app, Settings, Branding, no branding yet

steps.action: Pick a brand colour and a background tone
user_sees: The preview in the chosen colours
must_not: Colours lost before Save

steps.action: Upload a PNG logo under 1 MB
user_sees: The logo in the preview, and how it looks as an icon on a member's home screen
must_not: Another gym's logo

steps.action: Choose the heading style 'Normal' or 'Bold italic' and tap Save
user_sees: The branding saved
must_not: A raw database message

steps.action: A member opens the app
user_sees: The gym's name and colours
must_not: The old MettleUp look after a fresh open

start: Branding page, logo on a plain white box

steps.action: Upload the logo
user_sees: Both logos side by side; the box taken off
must_not: The logo cut into

steps.action: Accept the colour the app suggests from the logo
user_sees: The suggested colour picked
must_not: A colour that is not a colour code saved

steps.action: Pick a logo over 1 MB
user_sees: 'That logo is over 1 MB. Pick a smaller one.'
must_not: The big file uploaded

steps.action: Pick a GIF
user_sees: 'That kind of file can’t be used. Pick a PNG or JPEG picture.'
must_not: The file saved

steps.action: Type a colour that is not a colour code
user_sees: 'One of the colours isn’t a colour code. Pick it again.'
must_not: The bad colour saved

steps.action: Front-desk sign-in tries to save branding (old app)
user_sees: 'Only an owner can do this.'
must_not: The branding changed by the front desk

steps.action: Remove the logo and clear the colours, Save
user_sees: The member app back to the MettleUp look
must_not: A broken-picture mark where the logo was

steps.action: Set them again
user_sees: Members see the new look on their next open
must_not: Members stuck on the old look

steps.action: Open the admin app as the front desk
user_sees: The gym's logo at the top next to the gym's name
must_not: The front desk able to change it

steps.action: Open the logo link signed out
user_sees: The logo opens (the logo store is public)
must_not: Anything but the logo reachable

start: Member app, joining a branded gym

steps.action: Join with the gym's code
user_sees: The app changes to the gym's name and colours
must_not: The MettleUp look kept after joining a branded gym

steps.action: Close and open the app
user_sees: The same gym look on launch
must_not: Another gym's look

start: First screen of a fresh app install with a gym code

steps.action: Join from the first screen
user_sees: The gym's look
must_not: The gym's logo missing where it is set

steps.action: Add the gym's logo to the home screen
user_sees: The gym's logo as the icon
must_not: A blank icon

start: Member joins a gym that set no branding

steps.action: Join and open the Gym tab
user_sees: The MettleUp look with the gym's name
must_not: Blank colours, a broken-picture mark, or white text on white

steps.action: The owner changes the colour; the member opens the app
user_sees: The new colour
must_not: The old colour kept for good

steps.action: Leave the gym
user_sees: The MettleUp look again
must_not: The left gym's logo or colours still shown
